Class PreparationScope

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.PreparationScope
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class PreparationScope extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Prepares molecule models in the background and keeps only the latest result for each named request slot.

For example, use the slot name preview for a screen's current model. Requesting another model in that slot discards the old result, including a result whose callback is already queued. Keep this scope in the screen or controller, and close it when finished to cancel pending work and suppress later callbacks.

Preparation builds data on the existing worker pool; it does not register molecules or create OpenGL resources. Supply an executor that runs your result handler on the required client or server thread. This class never chooses a Minecraft thread for you. Callbacks and completion observers run outside the ownership monitor. A callback that already passed its ownership check is in flight and may finish after close; queued obsolete callbacks are suppressed.
